module: Flowgraph node "Location by Name". Looks up a location by name in sitesData.locations.byName. Inputs: flow, sitesData, locationName; outputs: flow (true if found), exists (hidden), location (locationData). The editor allows hardcoding the name of the location selected in the Sites Editor.
notes: If the name does not exist, self._location is nil and `self._location.missing` raises a Lua error (no nil check).

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the node's internal state.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the node's custom properties in the flowgraph editor panel (ImGui).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the flowgraph editor (ImGui).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

work.desc: When the flow is active and the name changes, looks up the location and activates the flow output if it exists (not missing).
